Zullo to appear on multiple lines in the November 3rd general election East Haven State Representative Joe Zullo (R, 99) announced today that the State’s third-largest political party, the Independent Party of Connecticut, has endorsed his candidacy for re-election as State Representative in East Haven, securing an appearance for the incumbent representative on both the "Republican" and "Independent Party of Connecticut" lines in the November 3rd election. “I’m proud to be cross endorsed by
